findings.finding: The dev_server per-loader table (S2 1a) requires unknown/corrupt profile to be a hard error with a non-zero exit, but only `cmd_start` translates the resolver's `ValueError` into an error dict. The CLI/exit-code path (and any other `cmd_status`/`cmd_restart`-style caller of `_get_services`, not shown in the diff) is not updated: previously a broken profile silently meant "no profile" and the `dev_url` fallback kept working; now those paths can raise an uncaught `ValueError` (traceback) or return exit 0 with an error JSON.
findings.suggestion: Grep dev_server for every `_get_services`/`_load_profile_data` caller and route each through the same `kind`-aware handling as `cmd_start`; ensure the CLI maps `kind` to exit 2/3.

findings.finding: Public module-level helpers were deleted outright. The S3 audit list (`inference.py`, `orchestrator_pkg/`, `lib/cmd_resolver.py`, `playwright_setup.py`, `adopt_`) has not run yet, so any out-of-diff importer of `test_runner.default_profile_path` or `validate_env.load_profile` now fails with `ImportError` at import time — including the plugin cache tree until `update-marketplace.sh` runs.
findings.suggestion: Either keep thin deprecated shims for one release, or verify (and note in the PR) that no consumer inside or outside the diff imports them.

findings.finding: For `not_found` with `origin="--profile"` (test_runner/performance_check CLI), the remediation text says "fix `profile` in shipwright_run_config.json …", which is wrong when the name came from the CLI flag. The test only asserts `"--profile" in out["error"]`, which the mis-leading hint happens to satisfy, so the test does not catch it.
findings.suggestion: Branch the hint on the origin: CLI origins get "check the `--profile` value or pass a valid name"; config origins keep the run-config text.

findings.finding: The new signature defaults `project_root=None`, so any caller that invokes it with just the name (the previous signature) silently loses the project/user lookup and resolves bundled-only — the exact class of silent misbehavior S2 is supposed to eliminate. The old monkeypatch seam (`_load_profile_data`) is also gone, which the diff only fixes inside its own tests.
findings.suggestion: Make `project_root` required, or assert it is not None for named lookups.

findings.finding: if isinstance(value, bool): return value` lets `port: true` pass coercion untouched; `True` then behaves as integer 1 in downstream range/validation paths, producing port 1 instead of an error.
findings.suggestion: Reject bools explicitly (`raise ValueError` for non-int port/timeout types).

findings.finding: When the run config names no profile (`no_profile=True`), the "not enabled" skip unconditionally overrides `cfg.get("skip_reason")` with `NO_PROFILE_REASON` even when `shipwright_test_config.json` carried a specific opt-out reason — an observable output change for existing consumers keying on `skip_reason`.
findings.suggestion: Only substitute `NO_PROFILE_REASON` when `cfg` has no explicit `skip_reason` (or track the two cases separately).

findings.finding: The legacy in-script map is now unreachable but still defined/imported, contradicting "remove every silent fallback" and inviting accidental reuse.
findings.suggestion: Delete `PROFILE_DEV_SERVERS` and its importers in this unit.

findings.finding: run_tests` is stubbed to always return `{"success": True}`, so the layer-skip and D9 assertions never exercise the real command string reaching a shell; a regression where `get_test_command` returns the wrong command but `run_tests` is stubbed would only be caught where `ran == [...]` is asserted — that is done here, good, but the "sentinel → npm test" and "legacy supabase → npx vitest run" assertions rely on the exact stub ordering and would not detect a command-injection-style mutation that appends to the command.
findings.suggestion: Also assert the full command string equality (not just list membership) in the sentinel/legacy tests.  Overall: the core S2 semantics (fail-loud resolution, provenance, D9 provenance-keyed defaults, sentinel table) are implemented and well tested; the findings are mostly un-shown callers of changed surfaces (dev_server exit paths, removed helpers) plus a misleading remediation hint — fix those, then ship.  SHIPWRIGHT_VERDICT: revise

findings.finding: The E2E branch still calls `run_playwright()` before reaching `get_test_command()`. A custom profile that declares an E2E command can therefore enter this branch and run Playwright instead of its declared command. The new tests exercise custom unit commands and missing layers, but never a declared custom E2E command.
findings.suggestion: Resolve the profile’s E2E command before choosing the Playwright runner, and honor custom commands. Add a regression test that triggers this branch with a custom E2E command and asserts which runner executes.

findings.finding: This S2 diff changes the resolver to address newly discovered gaps, contrary to D2’s explicit hot-file rule: only S1 may edit this file, and a resolver gap must stop and replan the dependent unit. The new source-gap tests explicitly confirm that these are resolver fixes being made in S2.
findings.suggestion: Move these resolver fixes and their tests into a separately reviewed resolver prerequisite, then resume S2 against that merged implementation.  Overall assessment: ship-with-fixes. Custom E2E command execution needs a regression fix, and the resolver changes need to follow the binding dependency contract.  SHIPWRIGHT_VERDICT: revise
